# Templates

Copy these; do not edit them in place as living docs.

| Template | Copy to |
| --- | --- |
| [feature.md](feature.md) | `docs/features/<kebab-name>.md` |
| [adr.md](adr.md) | `docs/adr/NNNN-short-title.md` |

The long-form project templates are the files in `docs/` itself (`function-plan.md`, `domain-model.md`, …). Fill those in rather than duplicating them.
